root_cause: Mira's actual scheduled source radar runs at 20:02 UTC (22:02 Europe/Amsterdam) for the following runDate. The shared assurance guard counted only rows updated after local midnight, leaving the source loop red for most of the next day despite genuine pre-collected sources. It also counted unqualified results such as irrelevant Nederland, Texas pages.

qualified_examples.title: ‘We hebben u gemist’, maar niemand aan de deur

evidence.production_guard_before: RED; 0 observed source rows after local midnight

change: Reuse existing powerhouse_refresh_regression_stage_evidence_v1; qualify observed source evidence across a rolling 24-hour window, requiring existing eligible=true plus evidence_score >=0.40 and total_score >=0.75. Leave producer, publisher, scheduling, RLS and prepublish gates unchanged.
prevention: A forward-prepared daily source is evaluated by evidence freshness, not by the midnight write-time boundary.
A score or source row alone is never evidence of a verified complaint; require existing eligible flag and evidence/total score.
Reject irrelevant results, stale sources and unverified content in regression, do not fabricate observations or publish content.
Keep source-stage GREEN distinct from Mira final media and provider post proof; every channel retains its own quality gate.
Keep one canonical Brain, Heartbeat, Powerhouse source and non-public privileged function grants.
